why: The INE results report of the fifth Recenseamento Geral da Populacao e Habitacao itself, cover-dated July 2025, rather than news of it or a superseded 2012 volume.
INE back in the field with a new Inquerito ao Orcamento Familiar nine years after the 2017 round, with over a hundred enumerators and results due by year end.
A distinct second survey event: ECA and INE launching a comprehensive national tourism survey with a design workshop dated 23 to 26 February 2026.
The ENDE document itself, the third national statistics strategy, beating PARIS21 status tables and news of the strategy.
A published national statistical yearbook compiled from routine health service records, the clearest instance of the thing itself rather than the enabling law.
A law in force from 26 March 2026 making the civil register drive the electoral roll by data sharing between DGRN and CEN, the largest in-window administrative-data step.
A distinct second event: publication on 12 January 2026 of a new enterprise dataset for the formal non-agricultural private economy.
The government data governance strategy and roadmap, whose own readiness assessment states there is no data governance policy and no promotion of open data yet.
The national NDT country report, the strongest national record of land-observation assessment reaching agricultural land use, with the Ministry of Agriculture in the working group.
The most recent authoritative peer review of the national meteorological service, prepared with the INM, describing its forecasting and satellite product use.
SOFF approval on 1 June 2026 of a USD 2.6 million investment implemented by UNDP with KNMI for two automatic weather stations and one upper-air station.
A distinct completed step: delivery and installation of meteorological instrumentation on Principe, including the island first complete aeronautical station.
The State Department country statement, the operative US record of what bilateral instruments exist, naming no BIT or tax treaty and no DFC programme to date.
An official bilateral visit of 14 to 16 January 2026 with the Prime Minister and Defence Minister, and the mission own record of the Starlink launch in country.
A distinct later event: the 20 August 2026 fifty-year anniversary reception, a meeting with the Foreign Minister and a visit to the Maritime Operations Control Center.
The founding instrument of the current relationship, published in full by China own foreign ministry, rather than a bilateral fact sheet summarising it.
A signed delivery and reception certificate for a Chinese medical donation on 4 February 2026, a completed step recorded by the signing party.
A distinct second event: the formal conclusion of the 19th Chinese Medical Team mission on 2 March 2026, recorded by the embassy.
The EU Delegation own country record setting out the Samoa Agreement framework, the 2021-2027 MIP envelope, the fisheries protocol and the Global Gateway water project.
An actual signed bilateral instrument in the window: the 2025-2029 fisheries protocol signed and provisionally applied from 6 October 2025.
The clearest named signed Gulf bilateral instrument with Sao Tome and Principe published on a signing party own site, naming both signatories.
The only in-window Gulf-linked commitment naming the country on an official page: a signed contract with the UAE-led Atlas Sovereign Smart Solutions for data centre and AI infrastructure.
India own consolidated country brief dated 31 March 2026, enumerating every signed bilateral instrument, grant, donation and the ISA and NTPC solar activity.
A dated in-window bilateral working event under the 2018 traditional medicines MoU, with senior officers of the Ministry of Health present.
